turns.input: Hadrik Voss gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Hadrik Voss reaches into his pack and produces a pair of leather boots, which he extends toward Nicco. "Brought these. Nothing special, just shop stock that happened to fit your measure from yesterday." He keeps his magnifying lenses on his nose, examining Nicco's face with the same patience he might apply to a blade's edge. "Wool lining's decent. Won't rot if you walk through puddles."

He does not release them until Nicco's hands close around the leather, and once the transfer is complete, he adjusts his grip on his own pack and seems ready to continue whatever business brought him to the square.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Hadrik Voss looks at the boots as Nicco extends them, then meets his eyes with a flat, appraising stare. "They're not a loan," he says. "Shop stock, already measured to you. I've no use for boots that size." He does not reach for them, his broad hands staying at his sides. "Keep them, sell them, leave them on a bench. Your choice."

A pair of passers-by cross the square behind him, their conversation fading as they move toward the low buildings beyond. The afternoon light catches the small rectangular lenses still perched on his nose from some earlier inspection. He studies Nicco's face with the same patience he might apply to a cracked blade haft, waiting for the matter to conclude.
